title: She Took the Elevator With 12 Bad Guys
altTitles: Never Share an Elevator With Nova
description: Nova took the elevator with 12 bad guys. Bolt took the next one. #stickfigure #animation #shorts
topic: S05 F6 gag loop × F5 implied fight: Nova in the elevator with the goons

sections.label: S1 Two, please
sections.videoPrompt: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. NOVA: a tall slender black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, magenta (#FF3DA5) glowing eyes and rim light, a single curved topknot line rising from the head, carrying a glowing magenta bo staff holding the glowing magenta bo staff in her right hand. GOON: a grey ink extra, a plain black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, steel-grey (#9AA4B2) glowing eyes and rim light, crimson ink smears on the shoulders, no accessories, a packed crowd of them. Vertical frame. In a warm marble hotel lobby, ornate brass elevator doors slide open to reveal a tightly packed crowd of goons staring out; Nova steps calmly inside and turns to face front as the doors begin to close. Locked-off symmetrical vertical shot, static camera, 35mm, warm lobby light, blank unmarked brass. Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, human faces, skin, hair, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fingers except three rounded nubs in close-ups, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds.

qc: S05: Drift — Nova's staff present in every shot; goons stay grey. Limbs — goon heap (S3/S6) tangle; OK if it reads as a heap with no stray limbs pointing out >3 frames. Faces — goon crowd close-ups in S1. Style — the lobby stays 3D, not a flat backdrop. Seam — loop: S6 end = S2 closed doors (KF-S05-02), door framing must match within 3%. Text — no numbers or letters on the doors or the indicator lamp; the floor digits are Remotion labels only. Muzak must run under every cut. Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused limb ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; stitch seam at 30s: position jump >5% width, lighting flip, prop changing hands, screen-direction reversal = regenerate the later segment; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
